description: Lists bills that have received Royal Assent and become Acts of Parliament, most recent first, with the Royal Assent date and the Act's title. For compliance, HR and legal teams who need to hear about new Acts quickly. Source: UK Parliament Bills API. It covers UK Parliament Acts only, not commencement dates or statutory instruments, and does not show the Act text (see legislation.gov.uk). (cost: 1 credit)

take.description: integer, optional, Acts to return 1-100, default 10

name: acts_recent_royal_assent
